battle.name: 628-632年薩珊王朝內戰
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞與美迪亞
battle.brief: 628 年 2 月霍斯勞二世為長子卡瓦德二世所弒，薩珊王位在四年間五次易手：沙赫多赫特、霍斯勞三世、阿拉德希爾三世、女王博蘭、女王阿扎爾米多赫特，最後由雅茲德格爾德三世於 632 年收拾殘局。同期拜占庭皇帝希拉克略斯攻入美索不達米亞、劫掠泰西封，阿拉伯騎兵則越過幼發拉底河反覆襲擾。卡面的希臘重步兵是公元前五世紀的裝束，一千一百多年後早已退場，但它所憑的「互相遮蔽」正是這場內戰裡薩珊真正喪失的東西。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場內戰的交戰方全部來自薩珊帝國自身，而兩位外部強權同時在帝國邊界開火。薩珊一方依帕爾西語傳統的編制，由 spahbadan（軍團統帥）、wuzurg（王家貴族議會）成員、各地總督、宮廷禁軍，以及以薩瓦蘭重騎兵為骨幹的常備軍構成；其兵源包含伊朗諸部的騎士團、亞美尼亞與高加索的附屬軍，以及居住在美索不達米亞北岸、以希臘語與阿拉姆語為通用語的基督徒邊境民團，這批希臘語民團是帝國境內最接近希臘重步兵傳統的部隊。壓在西線的是拜占庭帝國，皇帝希拉克略斯於 627 年自小亞細亞與敘利亞方向反攻，628 年春進入美索不達米亞並劫掠泰西封，628 年 12 月在尼尼微取得決定性勝利並奪回真十字架。東線上，629 年起阿拉伯聯軍騎兵越過幼發拉底河，不斷襲擊美索不達米亞的城鎮與鄉村。真正在薩珊宮廷內開火的是霍斯勞二世的諸子與支持者：弒父的卡瓦德二世（後稱沙赫多赫特）、起兵自立的霍斯勞三世與阿拉德希爾三世，以及扶立博蘭與阿扎爾米多赫特的 spahbadan 集團；亞美尼亞方面，西夫尼克的瓦漢與阿爾塔瓦茲德自 628 年起脫離帝國，北方高加索與西伊朗的總督則各自觀望。內戰的實質，是帝國用來維繫各地的四種結構——王位繼承、spahbadan 的效忠、拜占庭前線的指揮、與美索不達米亞的稅收——同時崩解的過程。
countriesEn: Every belligerent in this civil war came from the Sasanian Empire itself, while two external powers were simultaneously firing at the empire's frontiers. The Sasanian side was organised along Pahlavi lines out of the spahbadan (the generals who commanded the army districts), the members of the wuzurg (the royal council of nobles), the provincial governors, the palace guard, and a standing army whose backbone was the savaran heavy cavalry; its manpower came from the horsemen of the Iranian tribes, the auxiliaries of Armenia and the Caucasus, and the Christian frontier communities of the northern bank of Mesopotamia, whose common languages were Greek and Aramaic — that last body being the closest thing inside the empire to the Greek hoplite tradition. Pressing on the western front was the Byzantine Empire: the emperor Heraclius counter-attacked in 627 from the direction of Asia Minor and Syria, entered Mesopotamia in the spring of 628 and sacked Ctesiphon, and won a decisive battle at Nineveh in December 628, recovering the True Cross. On the eastern front, from 629 onward, Arab coalition cavalry kept crossing the Euphrates and raiding the towns and villages of Mesopotamia. Those actually firing inside the Sasanian court were the sons of Khosrow II and their supporters: the parricide Kavadh II, later Shahdokht, the self-styled rebels Khosrow III and Ardashir III, and the spahbadan group that put Boran and Azarmidokht on the throne; in Armenia, Vahan of Siwnik and Artavazd broke away from the empire from 628, while the governors of the northern Caucasus and of western Iran watched and waited. The substance of the civil war was the simultaneous collapse of the four structures that had held the empire together — royal succession, the loyalty of the spahbadan, the command of the Byzantine front, and the tax revenues of Mesopotamia.
people: 霍斯勞二世（590 年至 628 年在位）是這場內戰的第一位死者。他在位三十八年間推行中央集權，沒收貴族莊園、削弱大氏族的世襲權力，晚年更因猜忌而處死太子、數名兄弟、亞美尼亞基督徒出身的權臣佩羅茲，並把大將沙赫巴拉茲的家人牽入清洗。628 年 2 月，他準備東巡美迪亞、廢黜長子另立幼子的消息走漏，長子卡瓦德二世先發制人，在宮中弒殺他，屍體一度被秘藏數日。卡瓦德二世即位後改名沙赫多赫特，數月之內處死沙赫巴拉茲，清洗其家族與支持者，又陸續殺死霍斯勞二世的其他兒子。沙赫巴拉茲是亞美尼亞裔將領，613 年攻陷安條克、626 年圍困君士坦丁堡，是帝國最能應付拜占庭的指揮官；他被處決之後，西部戰線與宮廷之間再無可以獨當一面的元帥。另有三位女性與貴族在王位輪替中扮演關鍵角色：博蘭是霍斯勞二世之女，630 年在 spahbadan 的推戴下於泰西封即位，是薩珊史上唯一被正式尊為國王的女性；631 年她被刺殺，妹妹阿扎爾米多赫特隨即即位。支持博蘭的軍團統帥馬哈－阿杜爾·布萬在博蘭死後拒絕轉而支持阿扎爾米多赫特，隨即遭清算而死。632 年，霍斯勞二世之孫雅茲德格爾德三世被貴族推戴於美迪亞與泰西封一帶，成為薩珊末代國王；他在札卜河敗於阿拉伯聯軍，651 年在木鹿被殺。西線的對手希拉克略斯親自指揮拜占庭軍隊，其麾下的亞美尼亞貴族瓦漢與阿爾塔瓦茲德選擇趁亂脫離薩珊。另有薩珊官員納爾塞負責與拜占庭談判，以停戰與賠款換回被擄的真十字架。
peopleEn: Khosrow II (r. 590–628) was the first to die in this civil war. Over thirty-eight years on the throne he centralised power, confiscated the estates of the great noble houses, and weakened their hereditary rights, and in his last years, out of suspicion, he executed his crown prince, several of his brothers, the Armenian Christian minister Peroz, and dragged the family of the great general Shahrbaraz into the purge. In February 628 the news leaked that he meant to travel east to Media, depose his eldest son and enthrone a younger one; the eldest son, Kavadh II, struck first and killed him in the palace, and the body was hidden for several days. Kavadh II, who reigned as Shahdokht, had Shahrbaraz executed within months, purged his family and followers, and put the remaining sons of Khosrow II to death one after another. Shahrbaraz was a general of Armenian origin who had taken Antioch in 613 and besieged Constantinople in 626, and was by far the commander best suited to facing Byzantium; once he was removed, the western front and the court no longer had a marshal who could stand alone. Three women and nobles played decisive roles in the rotation of the throne: Boran, a daughter of Khosrow II, was enthroned at Ctesiphon in 630 on the acclamation of the spahbadan and was the only woman ever formally honoured as shahanshah in Sasanian history; she was assassinated in 631 and her sister Azarmidokht was crowned immediately afterwards. The general Mah-Adhur GBukan, who had supported Boran, refused after her death to back Azarmidokht and was destroyed in the ensuing purge. In 632 Yazdegerd III, grandson of Khosrow II, was acclaimed by the nobles around Media and Ctesiphon and became the last shahanshah of the Sasanian Empire; he was defeated at the Zab by the Arab coalition and killed at Merv in 651. On the opposite front the emperor Heraclius personally commanded the Byzantine army, while the Armenian nobles Vahan and Artavazd chose the moment of the civil war to break away from Sasanian control. The Sasanian official Narseh was the man who negotiated with Byzantium, arranging a truce and an indemnity in exchange for the return of the captured True Cross.
kits: 卡面這件希臘重步兵，是約公元前 500 年以後定型於希臘城邦的典型裝束：直徑約九十厘米的圓盾（aspis）、科林斯式青銅頭盔、以麻布與皮革縫製的胸甲（linothorax）、重矛（dory）與青銅短劍，軍陣縱深八列，前列盾牌相接、矛尖越肩而過。這套方陣在公元前五世紀已被馬其頓與羅馬吸收改造，到公元 628 年，作為獨立兵種的 hoplite 早已消失一千一百多年；然而它以互相遮蔽取代個人勇力的原則仍以兩種後裔形式存活。第一種後裔在敵方：拜占庭帝國的末期軍制中，scutati 持盾兵與禁軍 tagmata 仍以大橢圓盾排成密陣，遮蔽自身與同伴，與晚期古代希臘化戰術手冊記載的方陣原理一致；628 年 12 月的尼尼微之戰，希臘風格的重裝步兵正是拜占庭陣線的骨幹，用密集盾牆擋住薩珊重騎兵的衝鋒。第二種後裔在薩珊一方：帝國境內以希臘語、敘利亞語為母語的基督徒邊境民團與受雇的希臘步兵，在美索不達米亞與高加索作戰時被編為輔助重步兵，裝備長柄矛與大型盾牌，編制與列陣都帶有方陣式的互遮觀念。薩珊軍隊自身的裝備體系則以重騎兵為核心：薩瓦蘭與阿薩瓦蘭騎士披鎖子甲或鱗甲，備重矛、複合弓與小圓盾，衝鋒時以楔形密集隊形破陣；步兵以大盾與闊刃鏟形劍聞名，接近戰中腳步遲緩但防禦堅固；國王象隊的戰象配備套象槍與背架，充當移動堡壘；攻城方面使用投石機、撞擊槌、雲梯與攻城塔，並以駱駝隊把糧秣與器材運過札格羅斯山與幼發拉底河上游的驛站。
kitsEn: The hoplite on the card wears the kit that became standard in the Greek poleis after about 500 BC: a round shield (aspis) about ninety centimetres across, a Corinthian bronze helmet, a cuirass of stitched linen and leather (linothorax), the heavy spear (dory) and a bronze sword; the formation was eight ranks deep, the shields of the front rank touching one another and the spear points carried above the shoulder. That phalanx was absorbed and modified by Macedon and Rome during the fifth century BC, and by AD 628 the hoplite had been gone as an independent arm for well over a thousand years; yet its principle of mutual cover in place of individual valour survived in two descendant forms. The first descendant stood opposite: in the last military system of the Byzantine Empire, the scutati shield-bearers and the tagmata of the palace guard still closed up behind large oval shields, covering themselves and one another, exactly as the Greek tactical treatises of late antiquity described; at the battle of Nineveh in December 628 this Greek-style heavy infantry was the backbone of the Byzantine line, and its dense shield wall absorbed the charge of the Sasanian heavy cavalry. The second descendant stood on the Sasanian side: the Christian frontier communities whose mother tongues were Greek and Syriac, together with hired Greek hoplites, were enrolled as auxiliary heavy infantry for operations in Mesopotamia and the Caucasus, armed with long spears and large shields and organised and deployed with a phalanx-like notion of mutual cover. The Sasanian system itself was built around heavy cavalry: savaran and asavaran horsemen wore mail or scale, carried the heavy lance, the composite bow and a small round shield, and charged in a tight wedge; the infantry were renowned for large shields and broad-bladed spade swords, slow in the approach but stubborn in defence; the royal elephant corps equipped its beasts with ankhis and platforms, serving as moving fortresses; on the siege side the empire used torsion catapults, battering rams, scaling ladders and siege towers, and moved grain and equipment over the Zagros and along the relay stations of the upper Euphrates on camel trains.
tactics: 這場五年內戰在戰術上呈現兩種完全不同的面貌：宮廷與腹地是快速政變式的決鬥，邊境與前線則是薩珊重騎兵體系最後的幾次大規模運用。內戰期間的戰鬥多由各派系武裝在都會與交通線上展開：支持者控制了泰西封的宮廷禁軍與控制著關卡的總督，就等於控制了美索不達米亞的稅收與徵兵；派系之間的勝負常在數日內決定，被逐出首都的一方往往直接退往亞美尼亞、波斯灣或呼羅珊，再就地集結貴族私兵與地方民兵重起爐竈。這種以城市與兵源為爭點的模式，正是薩珊中央集權在王位空缺時失去作用的寫照。對外戰線上，薩珊軍的戰術仍以重騎兵為核心：以密集楔形衝鋒選定敵陣的弱點突入，再以弓騎射擊擴大缺口；步兵在兩翼或中央組成大盾密集線，用鏟形劍與長矛抵擋，並由象群提供震懾。但面對阿拉伯聯軍的機動作戰時，薩珊重騎兵反而吃了虧：629 年起阿拉伯騎兵不斷越過幼發拉底河深入，焚燒城鎮後迅速撤退，不與薩珊騎兵正面纏鬥，使擅長陣戰的薩珊騎兵屢次撲空；634 年馬達赫部在幼發拉底河擊潰薩珊守軍，635 年沙基爾部在幼發拉底河上游與薩珊騎兵交戰後退出戰鬥，都是這種模式的結果。632 年 8 月的札卜河之戰是這場內戰結束後薩珊軍最後一次大兵團會戰：阿拉伯聯軍以步兵居中，槍兵與刀兵構成核心，弓箭手列於後方，兩翼各置騎兵，騎兵以投射武器擾亂並尋機衝擊暴露的側翼；薩珊軍中央為步兵與象群，兩翼為以沙欣、魯斯塔姆等為主的重騎兵。結果阿拉伯步兵頂住象群的正面衝撞，騎兵迂迴至側後，薩珊軍左翼崩潰，中軍隨之瓦解，魯斯塔姆與多名統帥陣亡。628 年 12 月的尼尼微之戰同樣顯示出晚期騎兵的脆弱：希拉克略斯以步兵方陣穩住正面，以火與投射物驅散象群，再令騎兵集中攻擊薩珊軍的側翼與指揮部。
tacticsEn: Over five years this civil war took two completely different tactical forms: in the court and the interior it was the quick clash of coups, while on the frontiers and fronts it was the last large-scale employment of the Sasanian heavy cavalry system. The fighting of the civil war proper was carried out by the armed adherents of each faction in the cities and on the roads: whoever held the palace guard at Ctesiphon and the governors who controlled the mountain passes held the tax revenues and the recruitment of Mesopotamia; the issue between factions was often decided within days, and the side expelled from the capital would simply withdraw towards Armenia, the Persian Gulf or Khurasan, there to rally the private troops of the nobles and the local militia and start again. This pattern of fighting over cities and sources of men is exactly what the Sasanian centralisation became once the throne stood empty. On the external fronts the Sasanian tactics still turned on the heavy cavalry: a dense wedge charge was driven into a chosen weak point of the enemy line, then the gap was widened with mounted archery; the infantry formed a dense line of large shields on the wings or in the centre, holding with spade swords and long spears, while the elephants supplied terror. Against the mobile operations of the Arab coalition the heavy cavalry was at a disadvantage: from 629 onward Arab horsemen kept crossing the Euphrates, burning towns and withdrawing quickly rather than being drawn into a set-piece clash, so that the Sasanian cavalry, superb in the battle line, repeatedly struck at nothing; the defeat of the Sasanian defenders on the Euphrates by the corps of Muadhah in 634, and the fighting on the upper Euphrates in 635 in which Saqil withdrew after meeting the Sasanian horse, were both results of this pattern. The battle of the Zab in August 632 was the last set-piece battle of a Sasanian army after the close of the civil war: the Arab coalition formed infantry in the centre, with spear and sword troops as the core and archers posted behind, and put cavalry on both wings to harass with missiles and then strike the exposed flanks; the Sasanian centre was infantry and elephants, the wings were heavy cavalry under commanders such as Shahin and Rostam. The Arab foot withstood the frontal charge of the elephants, the cavalry swung round to the rear, the Sasanian left wing gave way, the centre broke with it, and Rostam with several other commanders were killed. The battle of Nineveh in December 628 showed the same fragility of late cavalry: Heraclius steadied his front with an infantry phalanx, drove off the elephants with fire and missiles, and then concentrated his cavalry against the flank and the command of the Sasanian army.
data: 關於這場內戰的具體數字，現存材料極為殘缺：波斯中世紀史書大量散佚，薩珊方面的可信記載多賴阿拉伯史家巴拉杜里與塔巴里的殘卷，以及後世編年者的轉述，因此必須把文獻所記與合理推估分開。可以確定的是幾個時間與距離：霍斯勞二世在位自 590 年至 628 年，共三十八年；628 年 2 月或 3 月遇弒，卡瓦德二世隨即即位為沙赫多赫特；同年 12 月 12 日拜占庭與薩珊在尼尼微交戰，而尼尼微與泰西封在底格里斯河上直線相距約四百公里；629 年阿拉伯騎兵首次越過幼發拉底河；632 年 8 月札卜河之戰；634 年馬達赫部在幼發拉底河擊破薩珊軍；636 年 8 月 13 日雅爾穆克河之戰；637 年卡迪西亞之戰；651 年雅茲德格爾德三世在木鹿遇害，薩珊王朝終結。626 年拜占庭首都之圍，進攻持續約九至十日即告失敗，此役之後薩珊的攻勢由巔峰轉為守勢。兵員方面，巴拉杜里記拜占庭軍在尼尼微有步兵與騎兵合計以萬計的龐大兵力，數字明顯帶有阿拉伯史料常有的誇張；札卜河之戰的阿拉伯軍常被記為約六千至一萬二千人，薩珊軍則從一萬餘到數萬不等說法不一，現代學者多認為阿拉伯軍總兵力當在一萬至兩萬之間，薩珊軍更在其上。無論採哪個數字，兩份史料都同意薩珊方面在札卜河全軍覆沒式崩潰，多位大將陣亡。物資與財政方面，薩珊帝國以美索不達米亞的行省稅收、絲織品與銀器貿易支撐軍費，內戰四年加上拜占庭的掠奪，使這條收入鏈在 630 年前後多次中斷。
dataEn: Concrete figures for this civil war survive only in fragmentary form: much of the medieval Persian historical literature was lost, and the reliable Sasanian testimony survives mainly through the Arab historians Baladhuri and al-Tabari and through the transcriptions of later annalists, so the numbers recorded in the sources must be kept separate from reasonable reconstruction. What can be fixed are certain dates and distances: Khosrow II reigned from 590 to 628, thirty-eight years; he was murdered in February or March 628, and Kavadh II was at once crowned as Shahdokht; on 12 December of the same year Byzantium and the Sasanians fought at Nineveh, while Nineveh and Ctesiphon lie about four hundred kilometres apart in a straight line along the Tigris; in 629 Arab horsemen crossed the Euphrates for the first time; the battle of the Zab came in August 632; Muadhah's corps broke the Sasanian army on the Euphrates in 634; the battle of the Yarmouk followed on 13 August 636; the battle of al-Qadisiyyah came in 637; and Yazdegerd III was killed at Merv in 651, ending the dynasty. The siege of the Byzantine capital in 626 lasted about nine to ten days of assault before it was abandoned, and after that the Sasanian offensive had turned from its height into a defensive posture. On numbers of men, Baladhuri gives the Byzantine army at Nineveh a host of tens of thousands of foot and horse, a figure that plainly carries the exaggeration typical of Arabic sources; the Arab force at the Zab is commonly given as somewhere between six thousand and twelve thousand, while estimates of the Sasanian army range from a little over ten thousand to tens of thousands, and modern scholars generally put the Arab total between ten and twenty thousand with the Sasanians larger still. Whichever figures are preferred, both traditions agree that the Sasanian side collapsed at the Zab in a rout in which several commanders were killed. On materiel and finance, the empire sustained its armies from the tax revenues of the Mesopotamian provinces and from the trade in silk and silver plate; four years of civil war, together with Byzantine plunder, cut that chain of revenue again and again around the year 630.
cause: 這場內戰的直接起因是霍斯勞二世晚年造成的繼承真空。皇帝在位三十八年，權力高度集中於一身：他沒收大氏族莊園，削弱地方軍團的世襲權力，並把祆教正統的守護者與基督徒、景教徒官僚混編在同一套貴族體系裡互相猜忌。627 至 628 年間，他先後處死太子、數名兄弟、權臣佩羅茲，又下令搜捕並凌辱大將沙赫巴拉茲的家族，甚至把女兒的婚事當作外交籌碼。這些清算消滅了帝國最有效率的一批將領，卻沒有解決誰來繼承這個問題。外部壓力把真空變成爆裂。626 年波斯大軍圍困君士坦丁堡失敗，元氣大傷；627 年希拉克略斯收復安條克與大馬士革，628 年初渡過幼發拉底河直入薩珊心臟，劫掠泰西封。首都遭劫之際，宮廷對遠在前線的沙赫巴拉茲卻生出猜疑——他擅自處死佩羅茲、動用國庫、與拜占庭暗通款曲的傳聞，讓皇帝打算召回並貶抑他。628 年 2 月，正是這個繼承與召回的風波釀成弒逆：卡瓦德二世先下手，殺死父親，自立為王。還有兩條更深層的原因。第一是制度性的：薩珊的中央權力靠 spahbadan 的效忠維持，一旦王位空缺，軍團統帥、地方總督與宮廷禁軍各有自己的打算，帝國沒有任何機制能迅速而合法地裁定繼承。第二是結構性的：拜占庭與阿拉伯兩個方向同時施加壓力，而薩珊正把全部精銳投入西線，東線與腹地只剩二線部隊與地方民兵，任何一支有實力的武裝都可以趁亂自立。亞美尼亞總督在 628 年起兵，說明帝國的邊疆早已在核心崩解之前先行鬆動。
causeEn: The direct cause of the civil war was the succession vacuum created by the closing years of Khosrow II. For thirty-eight years he had concentrated power in his own person: he confiscated the estates of the great houses, weakened the hereditary rights of the provincial military households, and set the guardians of the Zoroastrian orthodoxy against Christian and Manichaean officials inside one aristocratic order so that they would watch each other. Between 627 and 628 he put to death the crown prince, several of his brothers and the minister Peroz, and he ordered the arrest and humiliation of the family of the great general Shahrbaraz, and even treated his daughters' marriages as diplomatic counters. These purges removed the empire's most efficient generals without ever settling the question of who was to succeed. External pressure turned the vacuum into an explosion. The great Persian siege of Constantinople failed in 626 and left the empire exhausted; in 627 Heraclius recovered Antioch and Damascus, and in early 628 he crossed the Euphrates and struck into the heart of the Sasanian state, sacking Ctesiphon. While the capital was being plundered, the court grew suspicious of Shahrbaraz, who was far away on the front: the rumours that he had killed Peroz on his own authority, touched the treasury and dealt secretly with Byzantium persuaded the emperor to recall and degrade him. In February 628 it was precisely this combination of a succession dispute and a recall order that produced the parricide — Kavadh II struck first, killed his father and took the throne himself. Two deeper causes remain. The first is institutional: Sasanian central power rested on the loyalty of the spahbadan, and once the throne was vacant the army commanders, the provincial governors and the palace guard each pursued their own interest, for the empire had no mechanism capable of adjudicating a succession quickly and lawfully. The second is structural: Byzantium and the Arabs were pressing at once from two directions while the Sasanians had committed all their best troops to the western front, leaving only second-line troops and local militia in the east and the interior, so that any force with real strength could raise its own banner. The rising of the Armenian governors in 628 shows that the frontiers had already begun to come loose before the core did.
impact: 內戰的直接後果，是薩珊帝國在最需要戰力的四年裡耗盡了最有價值的部分。首先是人：沙赫巴拉茲被處決之後，再沒有一名將領同時熟悉西線與宮廷；各派系互相清洗，禁軍、spahbadan 與地方總督之間的效忠鏈條斷裂。其次是錢：泰西封遭劫掠，美索不達米亞行省的稅收在派系輪替中時斷時續，遠征軍費與地方軍隊的維持費互相排擠。第三是疆域的連鎖反應：拜占庭雖在 628 年 12 月取得尼尼微的勝利並奪回真十字架，卻因遠征極疲、國內又生變亂，無力深入伊朗高原；阿拉伯聯軍則在 629 年之後把幼發拉底河中下游與美索不達米亞南部當作獵場，到 634 年已能整建制渡河作戰。從長期看，這場內戰是薩珊王朝從尚能一戰的帝國變成被兩面夾擊而崩解的帝國的轉折點。632 年雅茲德格爾德三世即位時，帝國仍握有美索不達米亞、美迪亞、波斯大部分土地與一支尚能作戰的精銳騎兵，因此能在札卜河與阿拉伯聯軍對峙；但 636 年雅爾穆克、637 年卡迪西亞兩役之後，兩大行省的喪失使帝國失去糧源與稅基，651 年雅茲德格爾德三世在木鹿被殺，薩珊政權終結，兩河流域進入伊斯蘭王朝時期。另一層影響在文化與制度上。博蘭與阿扎爾米多赫特是薩珊史上僅有的兩位女王，她們的即位與被弒，顯示晚期古代波斯社會中王室的女性在權力邊緣仍有一席之地；大量波斯貴族與祆教、景教學者隨拜占庭軍西遷至小亞細亞的以弗所等地，把薩珊的文書傳統、銀器藝術與天文曆算帶入希臘化世界；希臘語則在美索不達米亞的基督教社群中延續，成為後來阿拉伯統治時期的學術語言。兵器層面上，卡面這件 hoplite 所代表的方陣互遮觀念，雖然在薩珊軍中已不復存在，卻正是這場內戰的教訓：薩珊真正崩壞的從來不是某件兵器，而是讓部隊彼此遮蔽、彼此支持的指揮結構。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the civil war was that the Sasanian Empire spent the four years in which it most needed strength expending the most valuable part of itself. First the men: after Shahrbaraz was executed there was again no general who knew both the western front and the court; the factions purged one another and the chain of loyalty linking the palace guard, the spahbadan and the provincial governors broke. Then the money: Ctesiphon was plundered, the tax revenues of the Mesopotamian provinces came and went with each change of faction, and the cost of distant campaigns competed with the cost of keeping local troops in the field. Third came the knock-on effect on the frontiers: Byzantium, though it won at Nineveh in December 628 and recovered the True Cross, was itself exhausted by its long march and disturbed by trouble at home, and could not push into the Iranian plateau; the Arab coalition, by contrast, treated the middle and lower Euphrates and southern Mesopotamia as hunting grounds after 629 and was already crossing the river in formed bodies by 634. In the long run this civil war is the turning point at which the Sasanian Empire changed from a power still able to fight into one crushed between two fronts. When Yazdegerd III was crowned in 632 the empire still held Mesopotamia, Media, most of Persia and a body of cavalry still capable of battle, which is why it could face the Arab coalition at the Zab; but after the Yarmouk in 636 and al-Qadisiyyah in 637 the loss of the two great provinces took away the empire's grain and its tax base, and when Yazdegerd III was killed at Merv in 651 the Sasanian state was finished and Mesopotamia passed into the period of the Islamic caliphates. A further layer of impact lies in institutions and culture. Boran and Azarmidokht were the only two queens in Sasanian history, and their accession and their murder show that women of the royal house still had a place at the edge of power in late antique Persian society; a great many Persian nobles and Zoroastrian and Manichaean scholars moved west with the Byzantine armies to places such as Ephesus in Asia Minor, carrying Sasanian documentary tradition, silver-plate art and astronomical learning into the Greek-speaking world; and Greek continued in the Christian communities of Mesopotamia, where it became the scholarly language of the later Arab period. At the level of arms, the phalanx doctrine of mutual cover that the hoplite on the card stands for had long since ceased to exist in the Sasanian army, yet it is precisely the lesson of this civil war: what broke in Sasania was never any particular weapon, but the command structure that let the troops cover and support one another.
result: 就這場內戰本身而言，結果是薩珊王朝以雅茲德格爾德三世在 632 年的即位而勉強續命，但繼承問題並未真正解決：他由美迪亞與泰西封一帶的貴族推戴，卻始終未能重新整合被內戰撕裂的 spahbadan 與禁軍，也未能阻止帝國的核心軍隊在札卜河一役中遭到毀滅性的打擊。整場戰爭的勝負過程可以概括為幾個關鍵轉折：卡瓦德二世弒父奪位、清除兄弟與沙赫巴拉茲，短期穩住宮廷，卻同時拆毀了帝國的西線與兵源；沙赫巴拉茲之死使 629 年之後的西線無法再有效牽制拜占庭；博蘭與阿扎爾米多赫特先後被自己的支持者或反對者所殺，說明王位並沒有足以壓服諸公的制度性權威；馬哈－阿杜爾·布萬遭清算，代表帝國最後一次重建軍團統帥與王權之間的信任。外部條件決定了內戰的結局。拜占庭在 628 年 12 月的尼尼微取勝並奪回真十字架，於 630 年以納爾塞為代表談成停戰與贖金，邊境線大致回到幼發拉底河；阿拉伯聯軍則利用薩珊內部的空檔，在 629 年之後屢次越河襲擾，634 年與 635 年兩度在美索不達米亞得手，打通了向卡迪西亞推進的通道。當 632 年札卜河之戰再度重演同樣的格局——中央被突破、兩翼被迂迴、整個集團崩解——薩珊就再也沒有第二次機會。內戰結束的真正意義，不在於誰坐上王座，而在於薩珊的軍隊再也沒有恢復互相遮蔽、互相支持的狀態；薩珊最終輸給阿拉伯人的不是某一次會戰，而是此前四年自我消耗所留下的空殼。
resultEn: As to the civil war itself, the outcome was that the Sasanian Empire continued in name when Yazdegerd III was crowned in 632, but the question of succession was not genuinely settled: he was acclaimed by the nobles around Media and Ctesiphon, yet he never managed to re-knit the spahbadan and the palace guard that the civil war had torn apart, nor to prevent the core army of the empire from taking a ruinous blow at the Zab. The course of the whole contest can be reduced to a few decisive turns. Kavadh II's parricide and his elimination of his brothers and of Shahrbaraz gave him short-term control of the court while simultaneously dismantling the empire's western front and its reservoir of troops; the death of Shahrbaraz meant that the western front after 629 could no longer tie down Byzantium effectively; the deaths of Boran and then of Azarmidokht, at the hands of their own followers or their rivals, showed that the throne carried no institutional authority capable of subordinating the great magnates; and the liquidation of Mah-Adhur GBukan marked the empire's last attempt to rebuild trust between the army commanders and the crown. The external conditions settled the outcome. Byzantium won at Nineveh in December 628 and recovered the True Cross, and in 630 concluded a truce and a ransom through Narseh, so that the frontier returned roughly to the Euphrates; the Arab coalition, exploiting the gaps in the Sasanian state, raided across the river repeatedly after 629 and twice got the better of events in Mesopotamia in 634 and 635, opening the road towards al-Qadisiyyah. When the battle of the Zab in 632 reproduced the same pattern — the centre broken, the flanks turned, the whole formation coming apart — the Sasanians were given no second chance. The real meaning of the end of the civil war lies not in who sat on the throne but in the fact that the Sasanian army never recovered the condition in which its units covered and supported one another: what the Sasanians finally lost to the Arabs was not a single battle, but the empty shell left behind by four years of self-devouring.
